hotels.title: Family-Friendly Cretan Haven with Two Restaurants & Panoramic Ocean Views
hotels.description: Here lies your perfect Mediterranean escape off the beaten path for all the family to enjoy - Elounda Palm Hotel & Suites has everything you need to arrive in style and leave relieved. Elounda is found on an east-facing hillside overlooking Crete's Mirabello Bay, creating memories of a stunning sunrise that will melt into your memories. Featuring two restaurants for classy or casual poolside dining and the Mellow Bar for crafty Cretan cocktails, this Greek retreat will keep your appetite satisfied all day and nightcap. Send the kids to their dedicated pool and playground as the adults enjoy a dip in the outdoor seawater pool or a quiet moment at the Wellness Centre. The shoreline of Mirabello Bay is dotted with countless golden beaches, tucked into nooks that assure everyone has space to lay down a towel and savour their time in the Mediterranean.
